name: Beast/Monster Scales
description: Scales or hide harvested from a beast or monster creature. Provides natural armor and protection. The type of mitigation/limit bonus granted depends on the creature (physical, heat, cold, etc.).
properties: Standard: No benefit. Champion: +1 mitigation, -1 mitigation limit (type depends on the creature's natural defenses). Elite: +2 mitigation, -2 mitigation limit (type depends on the creature's natural defenses).
